title: 圆坡面稳站
description: 粉彩描绘宽圆坡面手点与分立脚点带来的细腻低位站姿。

art_direction.medium: linocut print with indigo shadows and ochre highlights
art_direction.scene: Create an original soft-pastel illustration of a fictional adult testing a large rounded sloper while standing securely on two low footholds. The wall is nearly vertical, the sloper sits at comfortable chest height, and a second broad handhold stays within an easy controlled reach. Show palms aligned naturally with the curved hold, shoulders relaxed, and hips supported through the legs. Use a medium-wide frontal angle that includes both feet and the thick clear crash mat below. Dusty peach, pale mint, and deep teal pastel marks create a quiet gym atmosphere. The adult wears opaque clothing. Avoid hanging high, tiny fingertip grips, captions, brand marks, or sudden movement.
